Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which proposed actions are supported by the applicable requirements? Select ALL that apply.

choices.text: The MOR investigates a physical shortage before making an accountable inventory adjustment.
A pharmacy overwrites suspected-diversion footage after the ordinary 14-day period without preserving the incident evidence.
A pharmacist exactly counts or measures opened Schedule II stock for the federal inventory.
A registrant delays the next federal inventory past two years to align it with a convenient year-end count.
A pharmacist estimates that opened Schedule IV container merely because it is below Schedule II.

III–V 라도 container 가 1,000 tablets/capsules 를 초과하면 exact count 를 요구한다. choice_analysis.A: 선택할 항목. 원인 조사·적격 adjustment 권한과 routine entry 를 구별한다.
